# Benchzy

> Benchzy is a workshop of free file tools that run inside the visitor's web browser. Files are processed on the visitor's own device and are never uploaded; there is no server that receives them. There are no accounts, no sign-up, no daily counters, no credits and no watermarks. Output is produced at the file's full size. The site is paid for by ads on the pages; an ad can see which page a visitor is on and can never see their file.

## Tools

- [Remove background](https://benchzy.com/remove-background/): Remove the background from a photo at full size, free, in the browser. The first visit downloads the removal program (44.3 MB, in 11 hash-checked pieces); the photo itself is never sent anywhere.
- [Free background remover, full resolution](https://benchzy.com/remove-background-full-resolution/): The same remover, on the page that states the full-size promise and the dated facts about the alternative that closes 1 December 2026.
- [Compress PDF to an exact size](https://benchzy.com/compress-pdf/): Shrink a PDF to a target the visitor picks (200 KB, 500 KB, 2 MB or a custom size), in the browser, with the exact final size shown before download.
- [Compress PDF to 200 KB](https://benchzy.com/compress-pdf-to-200kb/): The compress-PDF tool with the 200 KB target preset, for form portals with a hard 200 KB limit.
- [Compress image to an exact KB](https://benchzy.com/compress-image/): Shrink a photo to an exact target size in KB, searched by quality and dimensions, in the browser; the achieved size and its distance from the target are shown.
- [Compress image to 50 KB](https://benchzy.com/compress-image-to-50kb/): The compress-image tool with the 50 KB target preset, for forms and listings.
- [Merge PDF](https://benchzy.com/merge-pdf/): Combine as many PDFs as the device can hold into one file, in the visitor's order. Pages are copied, not recompressed.
- [Split PDF](https://benchzy.com/split-pdf/): Pull a page range out of a PDF as its own file, or take every page as a separate PDF.
- [Read a scanned PDF (OCR)](https://benchzy.com/ocr-pdf/): Turn a scanned PDF into checkable, editable text plus a searchable PDF. Pages are rendered at 300 DPI and read in the browser.
- [File size checker](https://benchzy.com/size-checker/): Read any file's exact size in bytes, its real format (from its bytes, not its name), dimensions, page count or duration, and whether it fits common portal limits.
- [Batch compress PDF](https://benchzy.com/batch-compress-pdf/): A folder of PDFs worked to one target size in a single run, with a result line per file and one ZIP out. The job the big suites sell as a paid extra.
- [Batch merge PDF](https://benchzy.com/batch-merge-pdf/): Pick a whole folder at once, sort the tray by file name, and merge it into one PDF.
- [Batch split PDF](https://benchzy.com/batch-split-pdf/): One page range cut from every file in a folder in a single run.
- [Batch compress images](https://benchzy.com/batch-compress-images/): A folder of photos worked to one exact KB target in a single run, with a result line per file and one ZIP out.
- [Batch convert images](https://benchzy.com/batch-convert-images/): A folder converted to JPG, PNG or WebP at one quality, with an optional maximum width.
- [Batch remove background](https://benchzy.com/batch-remove-background/): A folder of photos cut out at full size in one run, one ZIP of transparent PNGs.
- [Compress PDF, strong](https://benchzy.com/compress-pdf-strong/): Strong PDF compression with no target: the smallest honest result from the deep end of the ladder, with the photo trade printed on the result.
- [Interleave PDF](https://benchzy.com/interleave-pdf/): Deal pages from two PDFs together (A1, B1, A2, B2), with the second file readable back to front. The duplex scan repair.
- [Sign PDF](https://benchzy.com/sign-pdf/): Draw or type a signature and place it on your own PDF, drawn into the page itself. Self-signing only: no signing requests to others, no audit certificates, no legal e-signature claim.
- [Flatten PDF](https://benchzy.com/flatten-pdf/): Bake a filled form's answers into the pages so the file displays and prints the same everywhere. Annotations that are not form fields are counted and reported, never silently dropped.
- [Workflows](https://benchzy.com/workflows/): Chain the benches (merge, shrink, split, stamp) into named chains saved in the visitor's browser, then run a chain on dropped files.
- [Preset chains](https://benchzy.com/presets/): Ready-made workflow chains: invoice pack, portal pack, paid pack, seller photos.

## Tool hubs

- [All tools](https://benchzy.com/tools/): Every Benchzy tool on one page.
- [PDF tools](https://benchzy.com/pdf-tools/): The PDF bench: compress to an exact size, merge, split, read scans.
- [Image tools](https://benchzy.com/image-tools/): The image bench: compress to an exact KB, size checker, background removal.
- [Background removal](https://benchzy.com/background-removal/): The background-removal workshop: the remover, the full-resolution page, and the shutdown pages below.

## The remove.bg shutdown, in English

- [Benchzy vs remove.bg](https://benchzy.com/vs-remove-bg/): A facts-only comparison, checked 8 November 2026: free download size, credits, accounts, commercial use, where the photo is processed, and what happens on 1 December 2026.
- [remove.bg alternatives](https://benchzy.com/remove-bg-alternatives/): The alternatives list for after 1 December 2026 (Canva, Pixlr, Photoroom, Removal.ai, Pixelcut, Benchzy), each with its free wall stated and dated.
- [What happens to remove.bg on 1 December 2026](https://benchzy.com/remove-bg-december-1/): What closes, what happens to unused credits, where the API goes, and what to do before the date.
- [For remove.bg API users](https://benchzy.com/remove-bg-api/): A short factual note: the remove.bg API ends 1 December 2026, its official new home is Leonardo.Ai, and Benchzy offers no API.

- [Quitar fondo de imagen gratis (Español)](https://benchzy.com/es/quitar-fondo-de-imagen-gratis/): The background remover in Spanish, full size, in the browser.
- [Quitar fondo a resolución completa (Español)](https://benchzy.com/es/quitar-fondo-resolucion-completa/): The full-resolution remover page in Spanish.

## Standing pages

- [What free means here](https://benchzy.com/what-free-means/): The written commitment: no accounts, no counters, no credits, no watermarks, no download held for payment, no smaller free size, no upload — and the one real limit, the visitor's device.
- [Check it yourself](https://benchzy.com/check-it-yourself/): The no-upload proof. Run a job while the page lists every request it makes, live, or follow the steps to check in the browser's own network panel.
- [Credits and licences](https://benchzy.com/credits/): Every engine, model and library Benchzy runs, with its licence.
